messages:
anya: Heads up — big enterprise customer (NorthStar) pushing to start a 3-week pilot June 14. Their two asks: strict per-tenant data residency and very low token-cost profile. They want both for their procurement signoff.
ben: those are conflicting priorities. residency is non-negotiable; token-cost requires embeddings cache tuning + quantization profiles that we planned for v1.
sam: engineering note: we can do a conservative cache (short TTL) + one quantized profile now. full tuning/autotune is another 3-4 weeks.
olga: product tradeoff: short TTL increases egress to model and cost goes up, which defeats their cost ask. A smaller quantized model reduces cost but might affect LLM quality.
anya: proposal: do residency + a conservative quantized profile labeled "pilot-liteserve" and promise a V1 performance re-eval. call it a "quality-notice" in the pilot terms.
marta-legal: legal needs the pilot terms to include an explicit quality caveat and acceptance criteria for NorthStar. Also need consent for temporary debug logging and a data-retention window.en: ops/infra: residency work is doable in one week if we restrict to a single EU region and use tenant partitioning. We'll need an emergency fallback to our hosted variant if anything breaks.
sam: if we ship pilot-liteserve, we should add a quick A/B check to measure quality delta on a small prompt set. that can be automated and give a go/no-go signal during first 48h.
yaanya: typo lol - anya: good call. So decision flow: 1) implement residency partition + pilot-liteserve quant profile; 2) limit pilot traffic to 1.5k reqs/day; 3) run A/B quality check on initial 48h; 4) include rollback SLA + quality caveat + logging consent in T&C.
ben: ops asks for a playbook: canary ramp 5%/25%/60% over 36h, SLOs p99 < 700ms, error < 0.7%. Auto-fallback to standard model if both error and p99 thresholds breached.
olga: product agrees but wants explicit milestone tracking: pilot readiness by Jun 10, canary start Jun 14, health review Jun 16, decision Jun 18. Please update roadmap.
marta-legal: i'll draft the pilot T&C with the quality caveat and the logging consent. need product to confirm acceptance criteria bullets.
deploy-bot: pipeline scheduled: "pilot/northstar/residency-lite" deploy at 2026-06-09 23:00 UTC. status: queued.
anya: action items: sam - A/B automation + test suite (due Jun 9); ben - residency partition infra + fallback toggle (due Jun 8); olga - update roadmap & acceptance criteria (due Jun 7); marta-legal - draft T&C (due Jun 8). I'll notify sales after legal review.
olga: ack. i'll also add a milestone column in tracker to show passenger features deferred to v1 (embeddings autotune, deep cost metrics).
sam: will prototype A/B harness today and post results in this thread.
anya: thanks team. if any blocker pops, flag here and i'll escalate. :thumbsup:
